description: Open a real, cycle-exact Amiga 500 emulator in-chat (MCP Apps hosts only). Boots straight into AROS, a free open-source environment (no copyrighted Kickstart ROM involved), with a public-domain Amiga game already loaded and running. This is a fixed, self-contained retro-computing demo -- there is nothing to configure and no arguments to give it; call it when someone wants to see or play with a real emulated Amiga. On a host without MCP Apps support this says so as text; an emulator has no useful non-visual form.
name: amiga
